item.title: My 16 hours at the Accidents and Emergency department
item.description: (Update: The A&E experience was not ideal, but the medical professionals, nurses and doctors, were in their majority brilliant – polite, reassuring, accommodating – despite working in a really difficult, chaotic environment. I’m now in the ward for respiratory issues and they are taking great care of me. The post is an extract from my diary of July 3rd, where I documented my experience at the A&E – it should definitely not reflect bad on the medical professionals or to my current treatment.
